pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Good manners for an audience include (1 mark)
   A. being quiet and clapping at the right time
   B. throwing things
   C. walking around
   D. talking loudly

2. Percussion instruments make sound when they are (1 mark)
   A. blown with air only
   B. struck, shaken or scraped
   C. bowed with a stick of hair
   D. sung into

3. Which describes a false start in a sprint? (1 mark)
   A. Falling at the end
   B. Finishing first
   C. Moving before the last signal
   D. Running in the wrong direction

4. How is a kayamba played? (1 mark)
   A. By blowing into it
   B. By shaking it
   C. By plucking strings
   D. By rubbing a bow across it

5. How do you make a coil? (1 mark)
   A. Bake it
   B. Cut it flat
   C. Roll a small piece between the palms or on a table
   D. Beat it with a stick

6. Which is a sprint distance in big athletics competitions? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 metres
   B. Marathon
   C. 100 metres
   D. Half marathon

7. In this lesson's sequence, what comes after the crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. Netball pass
   B. Sprint start
   C. Side roll immediately
   D. Lower the hips to the mat

8. The crab walk strengthens the (1 mark)
   A. hair
   B. ears
   C. arms, shoulders and tummy
   D. eyes

9. What can you do to clean your working area after painting? (1 mark)
   A. Wash brushes and wipe the desk
   B. Pour paint in a stream where animals drink
   C. Throw paint on the floor
   D. Leave it messy

10. Which is a component of a folk song? (1 mark)
   A. Weight
   B. Price
   C. Distance
   D. Community of origin

11. When should you swim? (1 mark)
   A. In the dark
   B. Only when a teacher or lifeguard is watching
   C. Alone
   D. Whenever you like

12. Where must a player stand to shoot at goal? (1 mark)
   A. At the centre circle
   B. Behind the goal post
   C. Inside the goal circle
   D. Anywhere on the court

13. Free hand lettering means writing letters (1 mark)
   A. in capital letters only
   B. with a ruler only
   C. with a printing machine
   D. by hand without a ruler or stencil

14. In a prone float, you keep your body (1 mark)
   A. long and relaxed with face in the water
   B. standing
   C. stiff and bent
   D. curled with head up

15. What should be written on the portfolio label? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. A secret
   C. Your name, class and title
   D. The price

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give four safety rules for animal games. (4 marks)

17. Name three water games and say how one is played. (3 marks)

18. Why is it important to warm up before doing gymnastics? (3 marks)

19. Describe how to compose a short melody with d, r and m, and how to check that it is a good melody. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — being quiet and clapping at the right time
   The audience should listen respectfully.

2. B — struck, shaken or scraped
   A percussion instrument is played by hitting, shaking or scraping it.

3. C — Moving before the last signal
   A false start is leaving before the start signal.

4. B — By shaking it
   The kayamba is a shaker with seeds inside. You shake it back and forth.

5. C — Roll a small piece between the palms or on a table
   Rolling back and forth makes a long even coil.

6. C — 100 metres
   The sprints are 100 m, 200 m and 400 m.

7. D — Lower the hips to the mat
   You lower the hips, lie straight, then roll.

8. C — arms, shoulders and tummy
   The body is held up by the arms and legs.

9. A — Wash brushes and wipe the desk
   Clean-up shows responsibility.

10. D — Community of origin
   Components include community, type, message, participants and instruments.

11. B — Only when a teacher or lifeguard is watching
   Supervision keeps swimmers safe.

12. C — Inside the goal circle
   Shots must be taken from inside the goal circle.

13. D — by hand without a ruler or stencil
   Free hand means using only your hand.

14. A — long and relaxed with face in the water
   A long relaxed body floats better.

15. C — Your name, class and title
   A label shows whose portfolio it is.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Play on soft, clear ground; warm up; keep a distance from others; do not push or trip; drink water; follow the whistle. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Bubble blowing, treasure hunt, follow the leader, water tag, circle walk. One correct explanation.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three games, or 1 mark each for two games and an explanation.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Warm-up prepares the muscles and joints, prevents injury and helps you perform better.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: Choose a rhythm. Give each note a syllable, using steps. End on d. Sing it with hand signs. Check that it has variation and stepwise motion and that it ends on d.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of five valid points.
